headline: US Oil and Gas Rig Count Increases by 6 to 607
summary: The number of active oil and natural gas rigs operating in the United States grew by 6 to 607 for the week ending November 20, according to industry energy data.
why: The US rig count acts as an early indicator of future crude oil and natural gas output volumes.

impacts.name: WTI Crude
impacts.why: An expanding operational rig count suggests increased future domestic oil extraction capacity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
